topics.name: Industrial recommendation systems
topics.summary: Behavior-sequence encoders, contextual feature interactions, and uncertainty-aware ranking recur in recommenders for sparse histories and cold-start users. Evaluations emphasize satisfaction, relevance, and serving constraints when feedback is noisy or incomplete.

topics.name: Robust control and optimization
topics.summary: Feedback control and constrained optimization maintain safety under model uncertainty, distribution shift, and actuation limits. Barrier certificates, ambiguity sets, and infrastructure-aware allocation are tested on nonlinear vehicles, hydraulic systems, and charging networks.

topics.name: LLM-assisted software engineering
topics.summary: Developer tools pair language-model generation with domain adaptation, explanation controls, and ranking objectives that distinguish useful code from merely relevant code. HDL assistance and code-search experiments show that maintainability and resource-aware quality complement semantic correctness.

topics.name: AI for chemical and materials discovery
topics.summary: Chemical and materials workflows combine structured molecular representations with learned predictors and grounded checking. Reaction and property models use domain databases, geometric descriptors, and held-out evidence to improve search while exposing long-tail factual errors.

topics.name: Weather and renewable-energy forecasting
topics.summary: Generative atmospheric downscaling and wind-farm forecasting learn spatial or geometric weather structure from forecasts and observations. The recurring goal is finer-scale physical plausibility or more accurate site-level power estimates for renewable-energy operations.

topics.name: Reliable LLM agents
topics.summary: Enterprise and general-purpose agents gain reliability from execute-observe-correct loops, routing, specialist models, planning, and memory. Cross-benchmark and computer-use tests show that scaffolding and targeted verification matter, while gains vary with task decomposition and feedback.

topics.name: Agent trajectory evaluation
topics.summary: GUI state probes and graph-based trajectory metrics evaluate how agents act, not just whether they finish. Transport-style alignment tolerates reordered or redundant steps, while interface interventions reveal whether actions produce intended state transitions.

topics.name: 3D visual localization and reconstruction
topics.summary: Camera, LiDAR, inertial, map, and radar cues recover metric depth, pose, registration, or 3D detections. Calibration-aware learning, selective map initialization, cross-modal correspondences, and sparse radar acquisition improve robustness, recall, or bandwidth.

topics.name: Language-model representation geometry and interpretability
topics.summary: Transformer analyses probe latent beliefs, persistent features, cache dynamics, and decodable signals after sparse compression. Bayesian sampling, activation geometry, operator views, and decoder-aware autoencoders show that internal structure and recoverable readouts can diverge from output quality.

topics.name: Adversarial machine learning attacks and defenses
topics.summary: Adversarial learning studies attack perception or intrusion detectors with physical patterns, gradient-based traffic perturbations, and environmental stress tests. Robust training and rendering-based attacks expose transferability and the limits of narrow benchmark defenses.

topics.name: Generative media security
topics.summary: Digital-media integrity is addressed through high-capacity image watermarking, spectral deepfake detection, and temporal jailbreak analysis for text-to-video systems. Blockwise embedding, spatial-frequency fusion, and structured black-box search target distinct manipulation or policy failures.

topics.name: AI computing infrastructure and hardware co-design
topics.summary: Neural serving and AI-facility studies co-design computation with memory locality, chiplet placement, routing, device variation, and grid-forming energy systems. Expert-traffic reduction and LLM-guided physical-design objectives are evaluated alongside resilient data-center expansion and islanded operation.

topics.name: Speech and audio signal processing
topics.summary: Speech recognition, text-to-speech, and active noise control use compact or adaptive models under resource and communication constraints. Assamese and Hindi evaluations, teacher-to-student depth reduction, and delayed distributed filtering show practical gains alongside implementation and stability limits.

topics.name: 3D generative modeling and object-centric representations
topics.summary: Explicit geometric representations support generation and semantic editing of CAD surfaces, hand-object motion, and compositional scenes. Boundary-aware diffusion, synchronized point trajectories, and paired CLEVR interventions assess validity, temporal consistency, and intended attribute changes.

topics.name: Evidence-aware information retrieval
topics.summary: Retrieval systems rank support by provenance, time validity, and task usefulness, while adapted embedding models retrieve executable agent capabilities across unseen catalogs. Legal search, multi-hop answering, and marketplace benchmarks show that evidence quality and transfer matter beyond relevance.

topics.name: Multi-object tracking
topics.summary: Video tracking methods preserve identity through occlusion and visual similarity using persistent appearance cues, generative color representations, and sequence-level association. Results emphasize improved continuity and fewer identity switches, while missed detections remain a practical bottleneck.

topics.name: Player experience and gaze behavior
topics.summary: Game studies combine eye-tracking transitions among interface regions with player-authored documentation and retrospective interpretation. Attention patterns and later reflection reveal experience dimensions that outcome scores alone fail to capture.

topics.name: LLM safety and privacy
topics.summary: Safety interventions combine policy analysis, runtime transcript protection, and targeted adversarial-example selection. Red-team and privacy evaluations focus on reducing leakage, jailbreak susceptibility, and harmful behavior without suppressing useful capabilities.

topics.name: Vision-language efficiency and alignment
topics.summary: Vision-language systems reduce redundant visual computation or improve agreement between textual semantics and generated images. Evolutionary routing and shared-target post-training are tested for efficiency, transfer, and fine-grained alignment under complex edits.

topics.name: Robot manipulation and shared autonomy
topics.summary: Robotic manipulation systems model timing mismatches, operator assistance, and deformable-object dynamics across perception and control loops. Latency compensation, diffusion policies, collision-aware guidance, and video-learned digital twins improve responsiveness or long-horizon physical prediction.

topics.name: Efficient medical image segmentation
topics.summary: Medical segmentation work distills foundation-model cues or fuses similar channels into smaller networks for constrained deployment. Polyp and multi-dataset evaluations prioritize boundary accuracy, cross-domain generalization, and reduced memory or computation.

topics.name: Medical speech and clinical documentation
topics.summary: Clinical documentation pipelines combine speech recognition, medical terminology adaptation, and post-processing to turn audio into structured notes or summaries. Evaluations examine concept coverage and semantic fidelity, with hallucinated details, polarity errors, and meaning drift recurring.

topics.name: Multimodal learning with selective fusion
topics.summary: Multimodal predictors learn when text, images, or auxiliary streams should interact, especially with missing or unreliable inputs. Sparse representations, sample-adaptive routing, and selective fusion improve detection, recommendation, and sentiment tasks while showing that extra inputs can hurt.

topics.name: Structured and efficient LLM reasoning
topics.summary: Language-model reasoning becomes more efficient through decomposition, progress-aware uncertainty, validated intermediate constraints, and dense supervision. Arithmetic, optimization, spatial, and satisfiability tests indicate better solutions or less wasted generation when intermediate structure is managed.

topics.name: LLM post-training with trajectories and synthetic data
topics.summary: Post-training methods curate trajectories and teacher signals rather than applying reinforcement uniformly. Agent rollouts, failure-guided synthetic examples, and reward or logit shaping produce data-dependent gains, with selection quality and cross-model transfer determining the payoff.

topics.name: Long-horizon dialogue and literary simulation
topics.summary: Persistent dialogue and literary simulation maintain persona, world state, scheduled interactions, and evolving character goals over long runs. Memory mechanisms and trajectory-level evaluation distinguish coherent development from locally plausible but globally inconsistent replies.

topics.name: Efficient LLM inference and serving
topics.summary: Long-context and agentic workloads are accelerated with cache reuse, speculative proposals, suffix sharing, and load-aware scheduling. Serving and reinforcement-learning experiments show that throughput depends on batching, cache residency, acceptance rates, and workload timing.

topics.name: Evidence-grounded language-model reasoning
topics.summary: Knowledge graphs, structured databases, uncertainty estimates, and counterfactual checks make model reasoning more accountable. Answer quality depends on reconciling explicit evidence and handling plausible but false documents, not merely retrieving additional text.

topics.name: Multilingual and low-resource language-model evaluation
topics.summary: Under-resourced language evaluation combines native or translated tasks with clinical and general benchmarks to test whether English-derived rankings transfer. Translation artifacts, model scale, and local terminology can change both capability and safety conclusions.

topics.name: Algorithmic auditing and reliability
topics.summary: Reliability audits use counterbalanced question orders, source-complete reconciliation, and account-level sampling to expose failures hidden by aggregate scores. Language-model judgments can shift with sequence or conflicting evidence, while platform visibility gaps may vanish after correcting confounding.

topics.name: AI governance and deployment monitoring
topics.summary: Deployment governance specifies delegated authority, provenance, risk documentation, and monitoring signals, while behavioral diagnosis separates model capacity from roles, objectives, and institutional constraints. Failures should be attributed before selecting an intervention or drift response.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning for resource-aware control
topics.summary: Reinforcement learning allocates limited resources under hidden state, changing workloads, and transfer uncertainty. Recurrent policies, constraint handling, domain randomization, and wall-clock evaluation expose trade-offs among audit coverage, perception throughput, energy use, robustness, and training speed.

topics.name: Graph machine learning systems
topics.summary: Graph learning work targets transfer and scale through fixed-parameter encoders, synthetic temporal benchmarks, and out-of-core inference. Controlled graph generators support evaluation across structures, while sequential storage and GPU-CPU-SSD pipelines make billion-edge prediction feasible.

topics.name: Theoretical foundations of reinforcement learning
topics.summary: Foundational analyses address finite-sample policy identification and the principles behind entropy-regularized choices. Guarantees and axioms connect exploration, preference consistency, and how uncertainty should shape decisions in Markov environments.

topics.name: Representation learning for imbalanced and structured data
topics.summary: Representation methods account for density, rare targets, and latent modes instead of treating data as uniform. Density-aware synthesis and iterative mode discovery improve coverage of underrepresented regression regions and preserve variation useful for disentangled prediction.

topics.name: LLM agents for operational decision automation
topics.summary: Role-specialized and hierarchical agents automate numerical bidding and enterprise workflows through planner-executor decomposition, simulated interaction, self-improvement, and human escalation. Evaluations emphasize constraint satisfaction and handling exceptions that fixed rules or single agents miss.

topics.name: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversation
topics.summary: Conversation emotion models combine uncertain audio, text, and visual evidence with temporal carryover across turns. IEMOCAP and MELD experiments show that confidence-aware fusion and gradual state updates can improve recognition when modalities are noisy or partially missing.

topics.name: Skeleton-based activity and emotion recognition
topics.summary: Skeleton models capture relational motion through part-aware streams, rotation features, weak labels, and tokens aligned with RGB video during training. Emotion and human-interaction benchmarks show that visual guidance can improve skeleton-only inference while retaining efficient deployment.

topics.name: Multimodal video grounding and segmentation
topics.summary: Video-language systems first locate a queried subject or time interval, then propagate or segment the selected target. Long-video, viewpoint-change, and ambiguous-reference tests motivate confirmation stages, interval-aware rewards, and temporal consistency.

topics.name: Parameter-efficient neural model adaptation
topics.summary: Compact adaptation schemes isolate domain-specific updates or replace full retraining with expressive basis expansions. Orthogonal low-rank modules and polynomial parameterizations are evaluated for continual detection and multimodal transfer, emphasizing accuracy per trainable parameter.

topics.name: Formal methods for AI reasoning and verification
topics.summary: Formal reasoning systems combine automated proof search with trusted checking, while neural verification uses branch-and-bound search with lookahead lemmas. The shared goal is improving discovery or verification speed without weakening the validation path.

topics.name: Large language model evaluation and benchmarking
topics.summary: Model evaluation is framed as sequential uncertainty estimation, ensemble prediction, and blind relative preference rather than a single fixed score. Confidence sequences, diversity-aware performance laws, and peer comparisons reduce query cost or handle multiple acceptable answers.

topics.name: Behavioral auditing of language models
topics.summary: Controlled prompting and model-editing studies track collateral behavioral changes beyond the intended intervention. Persona instructions alter verbosity, coding compliance, and correctness differently across models, while refusal-direction edits can shift optimism and certainty on unrelated prompts.

topics.name: Multi-agent systems and artificial agency
topics.summary: Multi-agent research studies decentralized coordination, automated economies, negotiation, and stateful agency under competing objectives. Linear-program duality, fairness-aware allocation, switching control, and language-model surrogates connect efficiency with incentives, resilience, and coordination.

topics.name: Battery health and lifetime prediction
topics.summary: Battery-management models jointly estimate health and remaining life from irregular or incomplete charge histories. Transformer encoders and degradation-aware multi-task objectives are assessed on established cell datasets, with uncertainty imbalance between targets treated as a central design issue.

topics.name: Computer vision for wild great ape monitoring
topics.summary: Conservation vision benchmarks use camera-trap video, fine-grained annotations, and ecological splits to recognize great-ape disease or social actions. Temporal aggregation and visibility controls test transfer to unseen animals and locations rather than relying only on random frame splits.

topics.name: Environmental and digital health prediction
topics.summary: Health prediction combines interpretable supervised models with pollution, meteorological, socioeconomic, and passive smartphone signals. Country-level respiratory data and a postpartum feasibility cohort show the value of subgroup analysis and behavioral rhythms while highlighting context-specific biomarkers.

topics.name: Legal and sustainability document NLP
topics.summary: Domain document resources and extraction pipelines organize historically layered legal acts and corporate emissions disclosures. Multilingual text, OCR, table reconstruction, metadata, and evidence links support traceable analysis across long time spans and heterogeneous reports.

topics.name: Computational visual perception
topics.summary: Denoising networks and human color-name datasets reveal that visual interpretation depends on internal features and semantic context, not pixels alone. Layer interventions, psychophysical comparisons, fuzzy color categories, and entropy analyses connect learned representations with human perception.

topics.name: Information-efficient representation and attention
topics.summary: Information-theoretic and attention studies characterize trade-offs among rate, distortion, perceptual realism, memory, and associative recall. Perception-aware coding analyses and cone-based linear attention offer optimization tools and efficient long-context state updates with measured capacity limits.

topics.name: Causal inference and treatment heterogeneity
topics.summary: Causal methodology replaces unstable subgroup-count selection with resolution profiles and valid uncertainty bands, while embedding-based econometrics derives conditions for pretrained image or text features in treatment and demand models. Simulations and applied examples connect the theory to practice.

topics.name: Kernel and geometric machine learning
topics.summary: Kernel and margin methods solve structured learning problems through geometry rather than large end-to-end networks. Active-set hyperplane refinement and tensor-train RKHS regression target scalable optimization, automated kernel selection, and missing-data recovery in fMRI and dynamic graphs.

topics.name: Biomedical machine learning for omics and drug discovery
topics.summary: Biomedical learning spans temporal immune repertoires, metabolomics feature stability, molecular ADMET, and amyloid-ligand docking. Neural ODEs, multiverse preprocessing, magnetic hypergraphs, and cooperative binding rewards exploit longitudinal or molecular structure when labels and resolved complexes are scarce.

topics.name: Human-computer interaction and interactive systems
topics.summary: Interactive-system studies examine purpose-built interfaces for everyday analysis and campus payments. Interviews, comparison studies, RFID/Raspberry Pi prototypes, and usability observations surface gains in clarity and convenience alongside rigidity, prompting burden, and deployment concerns.

topics.name: Theoretical machine learning and computational models
topics.summary: Formal analyses of automata, finite-field polynomial networks, quantum learning maps, and deep logic-gate architectures study prediction, expressivity, stochastic interpretation, and depth scaling. The shared focus is preserving useful computation as models become nonstandard or deeper.

topics.name: Scientific and medical image reconstruction
topics.summary: Imaging methods reconstruct or classify difficult clinical and scientific scenes from limited, noisy, or indirect observations. Regularized CT, pathology-guided prostate MRI classification, and transformer surrogates for tokamak plasma tomography use anatomical or temporal structure to improve stability, fidelity, or speed.

topics.name: Robust visual detection and inspection
topics.summary: Detection under weak or contaminated evidence uses physics-informed soft labels for infrared targets and task-level evaluation for semiconductor defects. Results show that noisy boxes, super-resolution, and reconstruction fidelity can mislead unless operating-point transfer and preserved defect evidence are measured.

topics.name: Generative graphics and inverse rendering
topics.summary: Graphics generation treats curves and rendered appearance as structured objects: anchor-guided vector-font synthesis builds Chinese glyphs directly, while feature-guided diffusion searches opaque renderers without gradients. Both use staged candidate refinement to avoid brittle local optimization.

topics.name: AI-generated text detection
topics.summary: AI-text analysis combines n-gram style diagnostics with Bayesian data mixing and calibrated transformer classifiers. Cross-dataset tests emphasize out-of-distribution robustness, revealing that corpus composition and shortcut features can matter more than in-domain accuracy.
